about.greeting: Hello! I'm Pedro Gabriel and I'm 20 years old, I'm a Full-Stack developer focused on Back-end, almost graduated in Internet Systems and an Electronics Technician from IFMA Timon Campus.
about.journey: My programming foundation started with Python, where I developed solid logic that I now apply in the Node.js ecosystem. I specialize in building scalable APIs and systems using TypeScript, NestJS, AdonisJS, and PostgreSQL, always focusing on best practices and organization through Docker. Professionally, I stood out at Developer Community, where I worked on pilot project development and management assistance, and at ATI Timon, where I delivered the SEI system information portal.
about.objective: I'm looking for opportunities that allow me to apply my technical skills and grow professionally, contributing to challenging projects. My goal is to continue evolving in the development of complex solutions, always focused on performance, transparency, and innovation.

cards.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
cards.content: Non-profit developer community that carries out the development of real projects with the most modern tools on the market. I contribute to the development of web platforms and RESTful APIs, actively participating in all phases of the software development cycle, from conception to implementation and maintenance.
cards.footer: Technologies: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, NestJS

cards.title: Junior Web Developer
cards.content: Agency responsible for modernizing public management and driving digital transformation in the municipality, being the developer of the Conecta Timon app, which integrates over 200 municipal services for citizens. I worked on the web development team, contributing to the development of the SEI portal (Electronic Information System) with WordPress and Elementor tools.

cards.title: Business and Management Event Monitor
cards.description: Federal Institute of Maranhão (IFMA) - Timon Campus
cards.content: I worked as a monitor at the 1st Business and Management Colloquium at IFMA, assisting in the organization, coordination and support during activities. My responsibilities included helping with event logistics, ensuring the smooth running of sessions and providing support to participants and speakers.
cards.footer: Skills Developed: Event Organization, Communication, Teamwork

cards.title: Electronics Technician
cards.institution: Federal Institute of Maranhão (IFMA) - Timon Campus
cards.description: Technical course with emphasis on electromechanical and electronic systems, automation and maintenance. This foundation strengthened my logical reasoning and systemic vision, which I now apply directly to software development.

cards.title: Internet Systems Technologist
cards.institution: Federal Institute of Maranhão (IFMA) - Timon Campus
cards.description: Undergraduate degree focused on web, mobile and internet services development. Throughout the course, I deepened my knowledge in programming, databases, software architecture and full-stack development.

cards.title: Artificial Intelligence Technologist
cards.description: Undergraduate degree in Artificial Intelligence, focused on developing machine learning and deep learning models. This course allows me to apply my technical skills and grow professionally, contributing to challenging projects.

cards.title: IFReserve
cards.content: Project completed for my thesis with the aim of building a suggestive application for implementing new features in the SUAP system at IFMA Timon Campus. With a grade of 8.8/10, IFReserve is a sports court reservation system that allows users to book time slots for court usage in a practical and efficient way.

cards.title: Recipe List
cards.content: Mobile application that allows users to browse through different recipe categories, view complete details including ingredients and preparation instructions, and save their favorite recipes for quick access. Project delivered for the Mobile Development course at the Internet Systems program at IFMA Timon Campus.

cards.title: Any Recipe
cards.content: System where users can create an account, log in, register new recipes with details such as ingredients and instructions, and view a list of all registered recipes. Project delivered for the Web Development course at the Internet Systems program at IFMA Timon Campus, where I actively participated in the backend and contributed to the frontend.

cards.title: Product E-commerce
cards.content: E-commerce platform developed for selling various products. The application allows users to browse through different product categories, view complete details, add items to the shopping cart, and complete purchases securely. The system also includes administrative functionalities to manage the product catalog, orders, and users. Team project at the Developer Community, where I was responsible for backend development using Nest.js and PostgreSQL.
